description: Top-level course pages do not freeze transcluded mathematics
disposition: Use recursive current-revision Special:Export and revision manifest

description: Official Commons category has only Lecture 4 PDF; 57 expected lecture/worksheet PDFs are absent
disposition: Do not claim a complete official PDF set; rebuild locally

description: Official expanded LaTeX is body-only and contains HTML break artifacts
disposition: Sanitize deterministically and use a versioned portable compatibility layer

description: Official Electron Lecture 1 render contains edit URLs/navigation and a nearly blank last page
disposition: Retain as witness only; do not use as production master

description: Media files have heterogeneous per-file licenses
disposition: Require exact media rights manifest before admitting each asset

description: Brenner lacks explicit de Rham cohomology and a coherent Lie-group unit
disposition: Author a bounded original bridge after the spine

description: The proof invokes Picard-Lindelof for G although h is only C1 so grad h and hence G need not be locally Lipschitz
disposition: Keep the source argument but add an explicit edition note identifying the missing regularity or coordinate-proof step; do not silently strengthen the theorem

description: The alternative proof says a vector field and ODE can be transported through a homeomorphism although differentiable coordinates and sufficient local-Lipschitz regularity are required
disposition: Target makes the argument conditional on additional regularity and a local diffeomorphism and states that it is incomplete otherwise

description: The reproducible pdfTeX reader has id-ID language metadata and ToUnicode fonts but no structure tree or PDF tags
disposition: Do not claim full PDF accessibility; preserve extractable text and source and make the planned HTML reader the primary accessibility surface

description: Source labels the radial -(f')^2 term tangential and uses nonconstancy of f as the condition for tangential acceleration
disposition: Target identifies the f'' term as tangential and the radial term as normal; tangential acceleration requires nonzero second derivative

description: Source defines the second tangential derivative using fixed undefined P while gamma varies with t
disposition: Target uses pi_{gamma(t)} with codomain T_{gamma(t)}Y; exact protected deltas are hash-bound in PROTECTED_CORRECTIONS.json

description: Source figure macro says CC BY-SA 3.0 but the frozen current Commons metadata identifies CC BY 3.0 with GFDL as an alternative
disposition: Use the exact per-file manifest and label the target figure CC BY 3.0

description: The final problem declares h and g then defines Z=h^{-1}(d) while immediately assuming g is regular on Z so g is otherwise unused
disposition: Target defines Z=g^{-1}(d); the exact one-token protected delta is hash-bound in WORKSHEET01_PROTECTED_CORRECTIONS.json

description: The source claims angle sum greater than pi from pairwise non-antipodality alone and therefore includes degenerate collinear triples and unspecified major arcs
disposition: Target requires three distinct non-collinear points and the shorter great-circle arc for each pair

description: The source display label Catatan 1.3 does not match the standalone reader numbering
disposition: Target displays Catatan 1.1.3 which is the actual numbered item in this reader

description: The immediate source macros omit derivative-source contributors Episcophagus and AMK1211 and expose no Commons or license URLs
disposition: Generated attribution names all direct and underlying contributors and provides clickable exact source and license links

description: Source formulas render German operators kern and bild
disposition: Portable preparation maps them deterministically to international ker and im while preserving mathematical meaning

description: Four display full stops sat outside the Brenner punctuation arguments and rendered as detached lines in the standalone reader
disposition: Move each full stop into the existing final punctuation argument without changing the displayed mathematics

description: The edition caveat described the regularity only in prose and obscured the exact differentiability class
disposition: Use the compact typographic notation C¹ while preserving the same mathematical caveat

description: Two understandable literal compounds remained awkward in Indonesian reader prose
disposition: Use parametrisasi geraknya and penskalaan parameter waktunya secara afin without changing the mathematical claim

limitations: PDF has no structure tree/tagging; all fonts retain ToUnicode and the planned HTML reader is the primary structured accessibility surface.
